summary: NodeBB is a Node.js forum/bulletin-board: users (user:<uid> hashes: username, userslug, email, reputation, status online/offline/dnd/away, ban/mute state), topics (topic:<tid>: title, tags, postcount, locked/pinned/deleted, votes), posts (post:<pid>: content, votes, bookmarks, diffs, post queue), categories (category:<cid>: name, parentCid, topic_count/post_count, privilege groups), groups (group:<name>: members/owners, private/hidden), direct messages (chat rooms+members+messages), flags/reports and per-user notifications — all persisted in a KV + sorted-set store (Redis/Mongo/Postgres).

deleteNote removes only the note sorted set entry (history entry for the note is not separately removed; appendNote writes a notes:null history entry)
Notification.deleteAll does not remove the global 'notifications' registry entries, only the per-user unread/read index sets
